name: Perfect Wiki
description:
Perfect Wiki is a knowledge base for teams working in Microsoft Teams, Slack, and the web. This connector lets Claude work with your company's internal documentation: policies, onboarding guides, how-tos, and support articles.

What you can do:

Get answers from your docs. Ask a question in plain language and get an AI-generated answer, with links to the pages it came from.
Browse and read pages. List the pages in a knowledge base and open any page in full, including pages you link to by pasting their Perfect Wiki URL.
Write and maintain docs. Create new pages, nest them under existing ones, edit content, move pages, or delete old ones. Claude always reads the latest version of a page before editing it, so teammates' changes aren't overwritten.
Work across several knowledge bases. Connect one, several, or all of the knowledge bases you have access to, and search them together or one at a time.

Secure by design: You sign in with your Perfect Wiki account over OAuth. You choose which knowledge bases Claude can reach and whether it gets read-only or read-and-write access. Claude can never see more than your own Perfect Wiki permissions allow.

Example prompts:

"What's our parental leave policy?"
"Turn these meeting notes into an onboarding page under Engineering."
"Find outdated pages about the old VPN setup and update them."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Perfect Wiki to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Perfect Wiki to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.perfectwiki.xyz/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Perfect Wiki MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perfect Wiki provides these MCP tools: ask, create_page, delete_page, get_knowledgebase, get_page, list_knowledgebases, list_pages, and update_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Perfect Wiki?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Perfect Wiki in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Perfect Wiki MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perfect Wiki requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Perfect Wiki is developed by Perfect Wiki. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
